correctness.rationale: Evenness in X gives a nontrivial involution. Setting Y=X²+T²+1 on Z=1 yields quotient function field Y²=−T(T+1)(T+2). Translation s=T+1 yields s−s³, genus one with distinct cubic roots and j=1728. The projective fixed locus contains plane X=0 plus [1:0:0], but p is not on the quartic; fixed-plane section has polynomial T^4+T^3+5T²+2T+1 with discriminant 4257≠0 and hence four distinct points, consistent with RH genus 3→1. For any PGL transformation fixing p, matrix block upper triangular; X³ terms force shear b=c=0 and X² and constant coefficients reduce to q(Nv)=q(v) and r(Nv)=r(v). An independently recomputed exact Gröbner basis is {u−s,v,w,s²−1}, proving N=±I and marked stabilizer exactly C2. Independent patch Jacobian ideals establish smoothness over C. This does NOT assert full unmarked automorphism group.
